title: Can Food Timing Reduce Your Diabetes Risk?
official: Can Food Timing Reduce Your Diabetes Risk?
summary:
The goal of this clinical trial is to test whether food timing impacts metabolic health in healthy participants.

Participants will:

* complete 2 inpatient stays
* be provided with test meals
* have frequent blood draws

interventions.name: Day shift protocol - Diet order A-B
Day shift protocol - Diet order B-A
Night shift protocol - Diet order A-B
Night shift protocol - Diet order B-A

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy with no acute or chronic medical and psychiatric disorders
* BMI: 18.5-29.9 kg/m2

Exclusion Criteria:

* Smokers, current tobacco or e-cigarette use
* Drug or alcohol dependency
* Pregnant
